# The deprecated 'main' destination still carries importAddon, grid registrations and startWorker

## Context

While producing the AC-2 live receipt for #17895 (`apps/workstation`, SharedWorkers, race-free CDP auto-attach with live console previews), the instrument surfaced the REMAINING tail of the #8149 `'main'`-destination migration: ~50 deprecation warnings on a single workstation boot, none of them from the dock namespace #17895 fixed.

Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 20 open issues at 2026-08-30T22:57Z; no equivalent found. Prior art: #8149 (the migration, introduced the warning), #8366 (`registerRemote` exemption), #17895 (the dock-namespace instance, fixed).

## The Problem

Captured caller inventory (CDP arg previews, one workstation boot + one splitter drag):

- `Neo.Main.importAddon` — 6 dispatches with `destination=main`
- `Neo.main.addon.GridDragScroll.register` — 2
- `Neo.main.addon.GridRowScrollPinning.register` — 2
- `Neo.main.addon.GridHorizontalScrollSync.register` — 2
- `Neo.worker.Manager.startWorker` — ~35 (!)

Every one is a remote-method call whose `data` carries no `windowId`, so `RemoteMethodAccess#generateRemote` cannot swap the destination and SharedWorker port resolution falls to the last-resort first port. Consequences mirror #17895: correct-by-coincidence in a single window plus console spam; wrong-realm dispatch the moment a second window connects — grid addon registrations in particular are per-window main-thread state, so a torn-out grid would register its scroll sync against the wrong window.

The `startWorker` volume (~35 on one boot) additionally smells like a retry or per-instance loop worth understanding while fixing the routing — count it as an observation, not a diagnosis.

## The Architectural Reality

`generateRemote` (`src/worker/mixin/RemoteMethodAccess.mjs`) swaps `destination` from `'main'` to `data.windowId` only when the caller provides one. The fix pattern is established by #17895 (`windowId: host.windowId` at the call sites) and by the `Gallery.mjs` `promiseMessage(me.windowId, ...)` idiom. Grid addon `register` calls originate in grid components that know their `windowId`; `importAddon` and `startWorker` callers need a per-site look at which realm they actually intend.

## The Fix

Per caller family: pass the intended realm's `windowId` in the call data (component callers: their own `windowId`), or route via `promiseMessage(windowId, ...)` where the call is hand-built. Reproduce the receipt instrument from #17895's PR (workstation boot under CDP auto-attach) and drive it to zero deprecation warnings.

Decision Record impact: none (completes the #8149 contract).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: a workstation boot + one dock/grid interaction emits zero `destination "main" is deprecated` warnings (CDP or equivalent browser-plane receipt).
- [ ] AC-2: grid addon registrations carry the owning grid's `windowId` (unit arm on the payload seam, #17895-style).
- [ ] AC-3: the `startWorker` dispatch volume is explained in the PR (fixed if a defect, documented if by design).
- [ ] AC-4: full unit suite green in fully-parallel mode.

## Out of Scope

- The dock namespace (#17895, fixed) and the deprecation mechanism itself.
- The dead-port rejection contract (#17894).
